heading: INT. SUNDERLY'S HOARD - INSIDE A DRAGON'S TOOTH - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SUNDERLY'S HOARD - INSIDE A DRAGON'S TOOTH - NIGHT
A hollow in an ancient fang, wide as a cottage.
Gold coins pile up like dunes in the dark.
Dragon breath stirs the air, warm, sulfurous.
GRETEL VOSS, 20s, soot-streaked, sword drawn, edges toward a chalice on a gilt pillar.
Behind her, in the dark beyond the tooth, SUNDERLY, a dragon, enormous, ancient, amused.
Only its voice and an amber eye show.
Little thief. You are in my tooth.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: I noticed.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: It is the one that hurts.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: I'm sorry.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: You are not sorry. You are armed.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: Both can be true.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: Show me the sword.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: Gretel lifts the blade.
It trembles.
She lowers it.
Show me the other thing in your pocket.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: There is no other thing.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: There is always another thing.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: She pulls a small iron pick from her coat.
For the tooth.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: You came to pull my tooth?
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: I came for the chalice. The pick was for the lock. But the tooth is rotten. I can fix it.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: If I let you.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: If you let me.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: Silence.
The amber eye blinks, slow as a sunrise.
Then do it quickly.
units.name: SUNDERLY

units.text: Then hold still.
units.name: GRETEL

units.text: She wedges the pick into the black cavity.
The tooth cracks.
A scream of dragon, a quake in the gold, and a coin avalanche that buries her to the knees.
She laughs, spitting coins.
